guidance.malformedJson: Hook input could not be parsed, so the call was not blocked. Retry with a documented PreToolUse JSON envelope and review AGENTS.md.
guidance.oversizedInput: Hook input exceeded the reviewed envelope limit, so the call was not blocked. Narrow the tool input and review AGENTS.md.
guidance.missingField: Hook input was missing a required PreToolUse field, so the call was not blocked. Use the documented envelope and review AGENTS.md.
guidance.unsupportedSchema: Hook input uses an unsupported schema version, so the call was not blocked. Review and version engine support before relying on it.
guidance.unknownTool: Hook did not recognize this tool shape, so it did not block the call. Bound output at the producer and review AGENTS.md.
guidance.invalidToolInput: Hook could not normalize this tool input, so the call was not blocked. Use a reviewed tool shape and review AGENTS.md.
